question: I cast Fiery Encore, which has storm. Does each copy created by storm make my magecraft abilities trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each copy you create because of storm causes your magecraft abilities to trigger.
expected.answer: Each copy you create because of storm will cause your magecraft abilities to trigger.

whyHard: Copies are not cast, so players think only the original spell can trigger casting abilities, but magecraft also triggers on copies.
